svg.text: Recalls one of the Muse's stored patches (16 banks x 16 patches).
Requires MENU > MIDI > RECEIVE PGM CHNG: ON on the Muse.
Mod Wheel (CC1), Hold (CC71), Expression & Sustain are on the VOICE tab.
Pitch Bend is bidirectional; the Muse's other knobs sync per-CC on every tab.
No one-click 'pull': the Muse can't transmit its whole state. Turn a knob and the plugin follows.
